title: Birth, marriage and death
descriptionFa: اتفاق‌های مهم زندگی: به دنیا آمدن، ازدواج، جدایی و فوت.
referenceRows: 1998 · Omid + Leila: wedding, honeymoon in Kish

words.example: My sister is going to have a baby in May.
words.tipFa: got a baby نمی‌گیم؛ همیشه have/had a baby.

words.example: I was born in Tabriz in 1998.
words.tipFa: همیشه با was/were: I was born. نه I born و نه I am born.

words.example: Please write your date of birth on the form.
My birthday is on the fifth of March.
How much does the baby weigh?
We want to call our son Arman.
words.tipFa: call هم یعنی «تلفن زدن» و هم «اسم گذاشتن».

words.example: They called her Mina after her grandmother.
words.tipFa: وقتی بچه رو هم‌اسم کسی می‌ذارن: call someone after someone.

words.example: Reza is thirty-five and he is still single.
Do you live with your partner?
Are you married or single?
When are you going to get married?
words.tipFa: get married to someone، نه with someone.

words.example: We danced all night at my cousin's wedding.
The bride wore a long white dress.
words.tipFa: bride فقط برای روز عروسیه. «عروسِ خانواده» می‌شه daughter-in-law.

words.example: The groom was very nervous before the ceremony.
words.tipFa: اسم کاملش bridegroom هست. «دامادِ خانواده» می‌شه son-in-law.

words.example: They went to Kish for their honeymoon.
words.tipFa: go on (a) honeymoon: به ماه عسل رفتن.

words.example: They are separated, but they are not divorced yet.
His parents got divorced when he was ten.
My grandmother was widowed at the age of sixty.
words.tipFa: به زن بیوه widow و به مرد بیوه widower می‌گن.

words.example: My father was ill, so he stayed in bed all week.
words.tipFa: ill بیشتر بعد از فعل میاد (He is ill). قبل از اسم sick می‌گیم: a sick child.

words.example: Many people die of heart disease every year.
words.tipFa: برای علتِ مرگ از of استفاده می‌شه: He died of a heart attack.

words.example: The flowers are dead because nobody watered them.
words.tipFa: He is dead درسته. He is died و He is death غلطه.

words.example: His death was a shock to the whole family.
Many people came to her grandfather's funeral.

gapQuestions.sentence: Omid and Leila had a big ___ in 1998.
After the wedding, they went to Kish on their ___.
At the wedding, Leila was the ___ and Omid was the groom.
gapQuestions.hintFa: زنی که روز عروسی لباس سفید می‌پوشه.

gapQuestions.sentence: When Mina was born, she was very small. She didn't ___ much: only 3.2 kilos.
In 2023, Omid became ___ and died a few months later.
Mina wore black at her father's ___.
